files.description: Main EHI (ePHI) Export page. Describes two export methods: C-CDA single/multi-patient export and FHIR bulk export. Lists 22 data sections available for export. Contains broken link to old.endosoft.com/fhir/ for bulk export details.
Full-page screenshot of the EHI export page showing the two export methods and list of 22 available data sections.

FHIR API landing page. Describes EndoVault SMART on FHIR service and links to the FHIR API PDF documentation. This is the working equivalent of the broken old.endosoft.com/fhir/ link from the EHI page.
Full-page screenshot of the FHIR API page showing the SMART on FHIR description and link to the API PDF.

138-page FHIR API documentation PDF (dated 2022-11-25). Covers the full EndoVault SMART on FHIR API including OAuth 2.0 authorization, individual patient API endpoints for 18 FHIR resource types, Bulk Data Access section (pages 120-132) with NDJSON file endpoints for all 18 resource types, sample JSON responses, EndoVault API resources table, rate limits, and terms of service. This is the g(10) standardized API documentation, reused as the b(10) bulk EHI export mechanism.
EndoVault EHR cost disclosure spreadsheet (XLSX) from the mandatory disclosures page. Documents costs associated with certified functionality including EHI export.
